input.summary: Replace immediate cessation/deletion in 11.1 with a six-month transition assistance period at then-current rates, and anchor the 30-day data return to expiry or termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept immediate discontinuation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with no export, which also contradicts the 30-day return and certified-deletion mechanics in 11.2 and 11.3. We have replaced 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates and anchored the 30-day return to expiry or termination; 90 days of assistance is our fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination, Vendor shall provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates.

ops.oldText: Within thirty days after Customer's request, Vendor shall return
ops.newText: Within thirty days after expiry or termination, or after Customer's request, Vendor shall return
